column1: # repos components, computed (see lib/components.sh for the table format): the workspace action only where
mode    unsynced  -  ahead of or behind the upstream                       -
mode    todos     -  with open TODO.md items                               -
sort    recent    -  last commit, newest first                             default
action  go        -       go there: the shell's directory (from the tmux M-o popup: the pane's, else a new window)  default,become,builtin
action  edit      ctrl-e  open the repository in $EDITOR                   foreground
action  fetch     -       git fetch the selected repositories              foreground,reload
action  pull      -       git pull --ff-only the selected repositories     foreground,reload
action  browse    alt-W   open the remote in the browser                   silent
action  rescan    reload  scan every repository again                      background,reload
action  links     -       link every ghq repository into FZX_REPOS_LINKS_DIR (~/git)  foreground
printf 'action\tworkspace\talt-O\topen the repository as a tmux workspace (workspace open)\tbecome\n'
